title: Article bookmarking
purpose: Document candidate bookmark and bookmark-removal behavior for readers, including persistence across sign-in sessions.

scope.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

requirements.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

stories.text: As a reader, a reader can bookmark an article.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reader is viewing an article that is not bookmarked, when the reader bookmarks that article, then the article is bookmarked for that reader.

stories.text: As a reader, a reader can remove a bookmark from an article that they previously bookmarked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reader has bookmarked an article, when the reader removes that bookmark, then the article is no longer bookmarked for that reader.

stories.text: As a reader, a reader can sign in again and still see their bookmarks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reader has bookmarked an article, when that reader signs out and signs in again, then the previously bookmarked article is still bookmarked for that reader.

edge_cases.text: A reader may bookmark an article and later remove that bookmark; whether removal and re-bookmarking cycles are fully supported is not stated in the selected sources.

dependencies.text: Delivery owner and date are unknown.

risks.text: The selected sources do not state how bookmarks are stored or retrieved, so persistence across sign-in sessions cannot be confirmed without further implementation decisions.

open_questions: What storage mechanism or service, if any, is expected to hold bookmarks across sign-in sessions?
Should a reader see a list of bookmarked articles, and if so, what ordering or fields are required?
What should happen if a reader bookmarks the same article twice?
What should happen to a reader's bookmarks if the underlying article is removed or becomes unavailable?
